# Neurodisruptors

> Strategic sparring and cognitive architecture for non-linear leaders. Dr. Sven Mulfinger, based in Barcelona, works with founders, CEOs, boards and HR leaders across Europe (in person in Barcelona, London, Berlin, Paris, Madrid and Zurich, or remote) in English, Spanish, German and French.

Neurodisruptors offers confidential one-to-one executive sparring for founders and CEOs with ADHD, autism, giftedness, dyslexia, dyspraxia, dyscalculia or a twice-exceptional (2e) profile, with or without a diagnosis, plus keynotes, board working sessions and enterprise workshops. The work is built on the Spiky Profile framework and the book The Non-Linear Operating System, with research collaboration at IESE Business School.

## Offerings

- [Executive Sparring](https://neurodisruptors.com/#sparring): confidential one-to-one strategic sparring for the person who carries the final decision
- [Workshops and Keynotes](https://neurodisruptors.com/#workshops): Asymmetric Minds in the C-Suite; Bridging the Founder-Board Interface; Designing Systems for Cognitive Spikes
- [The Spiky Profile, defined](https://neurodisruptors.com/spiky-profile/): what the term means, its ten dimensions of spikes and valleys and how it relates to neurodivergence
- [What is a spiky profile?](https://neurodisruptors.com/#spiky-profile): neurodivergence (ADHD, autism, giftedness, dyslexia, dyspraxia, dyscalculia, 2e) seen through how a mind works on a good day and a bad day, with diagnosis left to clinicians
- [The Spiky Profile Framework](https://neurodisruptors.com/#framework): Map, Stress-Test, Scaffold, Translate

## About

- [Dr. Sven Mulfinger](https://neurodisruptors.com/about/): full profile of the founder; executive coach, offsite facilitator and strategic advisor; founding partner of Kuma Partners
- Same person elsewhere: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenmulfinger), [mulfinger.com](https://mulfinger.com), [Kuma Partners](https://www.kuma.partners/partners.html)
- [The Non-Linear Operating System](https://neurodisruptors.com/#book): How Exceptional Leaders Think, Decide and Build Differently (in review)
- [Academic collaborations](https://neurodisruptors.com/#research): IESE Business School, IE Business School
- [Frequently asked questions](https://neurodisruptors.com/#faq): thirteen questions with full answers
- [Full text for AI assistants](https://neurodisruptors.com/llms-full.txt): explainer, definitions and every FAQ answer in one plain file
- [Insights](https://neurodisruptors.com/insights/): essays by Dr. Sven Mulfinger on non-linear leadership
- [How to work with a non-linear founder](https://neurodisruptors.com/insights/working-with-a-non-linear-founder/): a guide for the COO, chief of staff or co-founder who holds a founder-led company together, with references
- [Neurodiversity, neurodivergence and the non-linear operating system](https://neurodisruptors.com/insights/neurodiversity-neurodivergence-non-linear-operating-system/): the medical model, the neurodiversity movement and an operating-system frame for leaders, with references
- [Why boards misread founder variability as unreliability](https://neurodisruptors.com/insights/boards-misread-founder-variability/): how a board can tell a different rhythm from a real struggle, with research references
- [Diagnosed with ADHD at 50: what a late diagnosis changes for a leader](https://neurodisruptors.com/insights/diagnosed-with-adhd-at-50/): why senior people find out late, with research references
- [Map your good day and your bad day](https://neurodisruptors.com/good-day-bad-day/): a non-clinical self-reflection prompt for your own AI assistant, using the Spiky Profile lens (not a medical diagnosis)
